EmailTemplate.subject: Cerner + Flywire: Better Together
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Major upheavals in the US are being announced seemingly by the hour, with most of them having a negative impact on revenue cycles.
In the past quarter alone, hospital visits were down roughly 50% across the country, causing a dramatic shift in revenue cycle strategy.
We’d be curious to know how you're ensuring that your revenue cycle processes are strong enough to handle today's increasing demands while remaining agile enough to meet the needs of the future?
We recently released an article designed to help you do just that, entitled How Future Revenue Cycle Decisions Will Be Impacted by AI and Machine Learning. <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/how-future-revenue-cycle-decisions-will-be-impacted-by-ai-and-machine-learning]]>
Machine learning offers a tremendous opportunity for revenue cycle leaders to fortify revenue streams and increase profitability by achieving better customer experiences, greater revenue attainment, increased cash acceleration, and securing stronger competitive differentiation.
Click here <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/how-future-revenue-cycle-decisions-will-be-impacted-by-ai-and-machine-learning]]> to read the article and learn more about the steps you can take now to be better prepared to face the future today.
